record_dispositions.source_kind: autograph letter with later examination postscript
record_dispositions.voice: Charles Darwin; quoted and editorial voices distinct
record_dispositions.date_assessment: 29 [September 1855]; day written, month/year supplied from historical context. New P7 examination follows main discussion without independently dated separate day.

reference_observations.description: P7 specimen newly re-examined during writing. Present no-cell result limited to that specimen, not all earlier observations.

evidence.quote: This I have just examined & broken up
I could not in this specimen detect a single cell with included nuclei or granules

reference_observations.description: Body distinguishes gut-formed glands from cement glands despite loose apparatus description.

evidence.quote: I cannot persuade myself for a second that they are cement-glands

unlocated_references.description: Huxley recent anatomical letter explicitly absent in editorial note; later published lecture cannot replace it. Recalled Leonard drawing not included in source.

previously_recorded_relationships.description: Previously accepted forwarding witness unchanged; no recount.
